==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I remember three distinct adventures. In one, I attend the graduation ceremony of a magical academy. There I am most impressed by the students who had mastered becoming humanoid birds.

In another, I am on a large farm with a big fence. The townspeople hate the farm, because they believe it to be cursed. The farm receives a lot of threats, but ultimately the townspeople are too scared to attack.

In my last adventure, I encounter a miniature society of living toys and flying fish. My amazement is interrupted by a man with a gun. I talk the man into putting the gun down and we end up becoming friends.
